entries.title: Automatic release publishing and permanent archive pages
entries.status: Published source · Deployment observations tracked separately
changes: Published releases, merged changes and observed gateway deployments are added by an automated publisher.
Archive pages preserve all historical IDs and links without a global entry limit; older pages remain accessible as history grows.

entries.title: Complete changelog history from day one
changes: Backfills every published upstream and maintained-fork release, the upstream primary-source timeline and the complete merged SaaS change history.
Removes the November cutoff, preserves existing permalinks and distinguishes historical source records from verified deployments.

entries.title: Connect your Namefi domains
changes: Adds Namefi account connection, portfolio sync, expiry dates, nameservers, auto-renew, DNS records and domain pricing for email-held and NFT-held names.
Shows unreported privacy and transfer-lock state accurately and directs unsupported registrar operations to Namefi.

entries.title: DomBot 2.1.0
changes: Adds Unstoppable Domains registrar support and improves Namecheap domain details and request pacing.
Improves Afternic sales-history synchronization, sync error visibility and scrubbed desktop logs.
Improves registrar-name matching in imports, currency formatting, release notices and upstream API timeouts; hosted queues retain their separate budgets.
Available in managed portfolios as engine 2.1.0-hosted.1, with hosted compatibility and the existing account and publication controls.

entries.title: Automatic changelog updates
changes: The changelog refreshes upstream releases and SaaS notes without a separate page deployment.
SaaS code changes require a changelog entry in CI. Saved updates remain readable if a source is temporarily unavailable.

entries.title: Reliable hosted changelog refresh
changes: Restores automatic feed refresh in the hosted changelog while retaining saved updates during source outages.
